entities.summary: David Pel is a Dutch tennis player who specializes in doubles. He has a career high ATP doubles ranking of World No. 27 achieved on 29 December 2025. He has won one doubles ATP title with Sander Arends. Pel was a Grand Slam finalist at 2025 Wimbledon with Rinky Hijikata. David Pel was a athletes & competitors from Amstelveen (b. 1991-07-09, Amstelveen). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
